name: Sweet Home
desc:
Inspired by the web-comic. 

You are trapped inside of a apartment building, and the residents seem to be turning into monsters.

Better Stages, better monsters.
Getting kill streaks unlocks moves and evolutions.

Controls :
Attack : M1/Right Trigger
Heavy Attack/Aim : M2/Left Trigger
Block : F/Button Y
Drop Item : Backspace / DPAD Down
Run : Left Shift/DPAD Right
Shiftlock: Control/ButtonL3 (press down left joystick)

**IF YOU ARE CAUGHT CHEATING YOU WILL BE BANNED FOREVER.**
